claude.sample_unit: hand surgery procedures (each with 4 education sources, rated by 5 surgeons)

links.outcome: Reading grade level of patient education materials versus recommended 4th-6th grade
links.effect: ChatGPT 4th-grade, ChatGPT scientific, WebMD, and Mayo Clinic materials exceeded recommended levels by at least four grade levels (10th, 14th, 13th, 11th grade).
links.quote: ChatGPT - 4th Grade Reading Level, ChatGPT - Scientific Reading Level, WebMD, and Mayo Clinic written materials on average exceeded recommended reading grade levels (4th-6th grade) by at least four grade levels (10th, 14th, 13th, and 11th grade, respectively).

links.outcome: Plain-language comprehensibility of AI-generated patient education materials
links.effect: ChatGPT prompted for fourth-grade level still produced 10th-grade text and did not adequately simplify information; quality was inferior to patient-friendly websites.
links.quote: When prompted to provide more easily read materials, ChatGPT generates less robust information compared to patient-friendly websites and does not adequately simplify the educational information.
